summary: A granular synth that plays clouds of tiny grains cut from a wave of the song or from a built-in source (a chord, bells, noise), played by notes: each note is a cloud of up to 128 grains in all, 5 to 500 ms long, 1 to 200 a second, read from a position in the source that can be frozen or scanned, with a random spread of position, pitch and pan, a chance of reversed grains and a window shape; a note transposes the cloud, an ADSR shapes it, and a Drone switch plays one cloud with no notes while the song runs. 16 voices. Use it for frozen pads, glittering clouds, slow textures, stutters and drones made from any sound. Live input and the audio of an audio clip as a source come later.
use_for: Granular synth for frozen pads, glittering clouds, slow evolving textures, stutters and drones made from a wave of the song or a built-in chord, bells or noise; played by notes or as a drone.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The sound the grains are cut from: one of three built-in sources made by code (a chord, inharmonic bells, filtered noise), or a wave of the song's wavetable
parameters.how: Chooses the source the grains are cut from: a built-in chord, a built-in set of bells, built-in noise, or a wave of the song.
parameters.sound: The chord gives pads and drones, the bells glitter, the noise gives breath and wind, and a wave of your own gives clouds made of that sound.

parameters.name: Wave
parameters.description: Song wave: the slot of the song's wavetable (1 to 200) the grains are cut from when Source is Song wave; an empty slot plays silence
parameters.how: Sets which wave of the song's wavetable the grains are read from, when Source is Song wave.
parameters.sound: Load any sound into that slot and the cloud is made of it; an empty slot is silent and the editor says so.

parameters.name: Grain size
parameters.description: Length of every grain, 5 to 500 ms, shaped by the window
parameters.how: Sets how long each grain is, from 5 ms to 500 ms.
parameters.sound: Short grains are grainy, buzzy and glitchy; long grains blend into a smooth, evolving texture of the source.

parameters.name: Density
parameters.description: Grains started each second by each note, 1 to 200
parameters.how: Sets how many grains each note starts every second, from 1 to 200.
parameters.sound: Few grains are sparse and rhythmic; many make a dense, continuous cloud. The level is kept steady as the cloud thickens.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Where in the source the grains are read, 0 to 100 % of its length (the point the scan starts from at each note)
parameters.how: Sets the place in the source the grains are cut from, from the start (0 %) to the end (100 %).
parameters.sound: Moving it walks through the source; with Scan at 0 it holds one moment of it, frozen.

parameters.name: Spray
parameters.description: Random spread of each grain's start around the position, plus or minus this many milliseconds of the source
parameters.how: Sets how far each grain's start position is scattered around Position, from 0 to 500 ms.
parameters.sound: Zero repeats one slice; a little blurs it into a pad; a lot gives a wide, shimmering cloud of the whole neighbourhood.

parameters.name: Scan speed
parameters.description: How fast the position moves through the source after a note starts: 100 % is the source's own speed, 0 is frozen, negative runs backwards
parameters.how: Sets how fast the read position travels through the source, from -200 % (backwards, twice as fast) to +200 %.
parameters.sound: At 100 % the source plays through at its own speed whatever the pitch; at 0 it is held still; slow values give slowly evolving textures.

parameters.name: Window
parameters.description: The grain's fade in and out: Hann (smooth bell), Tukey (flat top with soft edges) or Gauss (narrow bell)
parameters.how: Chooses the shape of each grain's volume curve.
parameters.sound: Hann is smooth and even, Tukey keeps more of each grain's body and sounds more distinct, Gauss is soft and diffuse.

parameters.name: Align
parameters.description: Phase alignment: a new grain starts at the point within up to 20 ms of its position where the sound already playing in the same note continues best, so tonal sources keep their pitch
parameters.how: Sets how far each grain may move its start to line up with the grains already sounding, from 0 (off) to 100 % (up to 20 ms).
parameters.sound: Up, a tonal source stays one clean tone; at 0 the grain rate makes sidebands and the tone turns buzzy or gritty.

parameters.name: Pitch
parameters.description: Transposition of every grain, on top of the note: 0 is the source's pitch at C3
parameters.how: Sets the pitch of the grains in semitones, from -24 to +24, on top of the note.
parameters.sound: Moves the whole cloud up or down; a note then adds its own interval to it.

parameters.name: Pitch spray
parameters.description: Random detune of each grain, plus or minus this many cents
parameters.how: Sets how far each grain's pitch is scattered around the note, from 0 to 1200 cents.
parameters.sound: A little thickens the cloud like a chorus; a lot turns it into a swarm of different pitches.

parameters.name: Reverse chance
parameters.description: The share of grains that are read backwards
parameters.how: Sets how many grains play backwards, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Backwards grains swell into their own end and blur the attack, for a shimmering, reversed wash.

parameters.name: Pan spread
parameters.description: How far each grain is placed at random left or right (0 % is all centre, 100 % anywhere)
parameters.how: Sets how widely the grains are scattered across the stereo field, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Zero is a narrow centred cloud; more spreads the grains into a wide, enveloping field.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Attack time of each note's cloud
parameters.how: Sets how long a note's cloud takes to swell to full level, from 1 ms to 5 s.
parameters.sound: Short attacks start notes at once; long ones fade pads in slowly.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Decay time down to the sustain level
parameters.how: Sets how long the cloud takes to fall to the sustain level, from 5 ms to 5 s.
parameters.sound: Short decays make a pluck of the cloud's start; long ones make a slow settling.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Level a held note stays at after the decay
parameters.how: Sets the level a held note stays at, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: At 100 % the cloud holds steady; at 0 it fades away even while the key is down.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Release time after the key goes up (time to fall by 60 dB)
parameters.how: Sets how long the cloud rings out after the key is released, from 5 ms to 5 s.
parameters.sound: Short releases stop the cloud at once; long ones let it linger.

parameters.name: Drone
parameters.description: Plays one cloud at the pitch of C3 with no notes while the song's transport runs; its envelope uses Attack and Release
parameters.how: Turns on a cloud that plays by itself while the song plays.
parameters.sound: Gives a constant bed under the notes, such as a drone or a texture, with no note needed.

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.description: The random stream that spreads the grains: the same seed repeats the same cloud exactly
parameters.how: Sets which random sequence the grains follow, from 1 to 100.
parameters.sound: Another seed gives another cloud of the same character; the same seed always sounds the same.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: Output level
parameters.how: Sets the final level in dB, from off to +12.
parameters.sound: It makes the cloud louder or quieter without changing its character.
